commonCards.name: Poison Dart
commonCards.description: Apply 3 Poison. Deals 3 damage at the start of each of the enemy's turns for 3 turns, ignoring armor. Stacks: another Poison adds its damage to the tick and extends the timer by 3 turns, up to 10.

commonCards.name: Torch
commonCards.description: Apply 5 Burn. Deals 5 damage at the start of each of the enemy's turns for 3 turns, ignoring armor. Stacks: another Burn adds its damage to the tick and extends the timer by 3 turns, up to 10.

commonCards.name: Weaken
commonCards.description: Weaken the enemy for 3 turns: their attacks land for 1.5x less damage. Does not stack - reapplying keeps whichever effect is stronger and resets the 3 turns.

commonCards.name: Uppercut
commonCards.description: Deal 10 damage. Ignores the enemy's defense stat entirely, so it lands full against heavily armored foes.

commonCards.name: Shield Bash
commonCards.description: Gain 4 armor, then deal 3 damage that bypasses the enemy's armor.

commonCards.name: Combo Strike
commonCards.description: Strike twice for 7 damage each, 14 total. Both hits are reduced by defense separately.

commonCards.name: Strengthen
commonCards.description: Gain x1.2 damage for 2 turns. Multiplies every attack you play, including riposte and counter damage. Stacks in duration, not power - a second cast adds turns and keeps the stronger multiplier.

commonCards.name: Taunt
commonCards.description: Provoke the enemy. For their next 2 turns they are far more likely to attack than to defend or cast.

rareCards.name: Power Strike
rareCards.description: Deal 19 damage.

rareCards.name: Fortify
rareCards.description: Gain 9 armor. It does not fade at the end of your turn: it lasts 3 turns or until an attack breaks it.

rareCards.name: Cleave
rareCards.description: Deal 18 damage.

rareCards.name: Body Slam
rareCards.description: Deal 18 damage.

rareCards.name: Molten Hammer
rareCards.description: Deal 25 damage.

rareCards.name: Guardian
rareCards.description: Gain 20 armor.

rareCards.name: Onslaught
rareCards.description: Strike twice for 10 damage each, 20 total. Both hits are reduced by defense separately.

rareCards.name: Retaliate
rareCards.description: Gain 7 armor. 50% chance to Weaken the enemy for 2 turns.

rareCards.name: Status Guard
rareCards.description: Gain 10 armor and ward yourself for 2 turns. Every ailment the enemy would inflict (Poison, Burn, Weak or Stun) is blocked while it holds.

rareCards.name: Toxic Cloud
rareCards.description: Apply 8 Poison. Deals 8 damage at the start of each of the enemy's turns for 3 turns, ignoring armor. Stacks: another Poison adds its damage to the tick and extends the timer by 3 turns, up to 10.

rareCards.name: Inferno
rareCards.description: Apply 8 Burn. Deals 8 damage at the start of each of the enemy's turns for 3 turns, ignoring armor. Stacks: another Burn adds its damage to the tick and extends the timer by 3 turns, up to 10.

rareCards.name: Shatter
rareCards.description: Weaken the enemy for 3 turns: their attacks land for 1.75x less damage. Does not stack - reapplying keeps whichever effect is stronger and resets the 3 turns.

rareCards.name: Stun Strike
rareCards.description: Stun the enemy so they lose their next turn. Never stacks - a second Stun while one is active does nothing. Bosses often resist it.

rareCards.name: Venomous Lance
rareCards.description: Deal 12 damage.

rareCards.name: Heal
rareCards.description: Heal 26 HP.

rareCards.name: Dodge Reversal
rareCards.description: Sidestep whatever the enemy does to you next and turn it back on them. An attack returns for double damage plus 6. An ailment (Poison, Burn, Weak or Stun) is applied to them instead, doubled. Fizzles only if they do neither.

rareCards.name: Iron Skin
rareCards.description: Gain 24 armor. 50% chance to Weaken the enemy for 2 turns.

rareCards.name: Bastion
rareCards.description: Gain 14 armor. It does not fade at the end of your turn: it lasts 3 turns or until an attack breaks it.

rareCards.name: Finishing Blow
rareCards.description: Deal 30 damage.

rareCards.name: Bloodlust
rareCards.description: Deal 13 damage, then gain x3 damage for 2 turns. Multiplies every attack you play, including riposte and counter damage. Stacks in duration, not power: a second cast adds turns and keeps the stronger multiplier.

rareCards.name: Cyclone
rareCards.description: Deal 25 damage.

rareCards.name: Virulent Plague
rareCards.description: Apply 14 Poison. Deals 14 damage at the start of each of the enemy's turns for 3 turns, ignoring armor. Stacks: another Poison adds its damage to the tick and extends the timer by 3 turns, up to 10.

rareCards.name: Hellfire
rareCards.description: Apply 12 Burn. Deals 12 damage at the start of each of the enemy's turns for 3 turns, ignoring armor. Stacks: another Burn adds its damage to the tick and extends the timer by 3 turns, up to 10.

rareCards.name: Sunder
rareCards.description: Weaken the enemy for 3 turns: their attacks land for 2x less damage. Does not stack - reapplying keeps whichever effect is stronger and resets the 3 turns.

rareCards.name: Great Heal
rareCards.description: Heal 40 HP.

rareCards.name: Reckoning
rareCards.description: Deal 40 damage that nothing reduces. Ignores armor, defense, resistance, and any stance or phase the enemy is hiding behind.
